IC1: - Cochlear Nucleus cochlear implant users [OR] or Advanced Bionics cochlear implant users
IC3: - Early onset of deafness (< 3 years of age); no requirement for age at implantation
IC4: - Late onset of deafness (> 3 years of age); matched in duration of deafness to the early onset group
IC5: - Has had device experience for at least one year
IC6: - Can be child [OR] or adult at the time of enrollment
